mapper.sql: eqp_key, socket_protocol_type, connection_mode, charset, heartbeat_enabled, heartbeat_interval, read_timeout, write_timeout, max_frame_size_bytes, keep_alive_enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_eqp_socket (eqp_key, socket_protocol_type, connection_mode, charset, heartbeat_enabled, heartbeat_interval, read_timeout, write_timeout, max_frame_size_bytes, keep_alive_enabled) VALUES (#{s.eqpKey}, #{s.socketProtocolType}, #{s.connectionMode}, /* charset NOT NULL + default('UTF-8') 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{s.charset}, 'UTF-8'), /* heartbeat_enabled NOT NULL + default(true) 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{s.heartbeatEnabled}, true), /* heartbeat_interval NOT NULL + default(30) 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{s.heartbeatInterval}, 30), /* read_timeout NOT NULL + default(0) 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{s.readTimeout}, 0), /* write_timeout NOT NULL + default(0) 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{s.writeTimeout}, 0), /* max_frame_size_bytes NOT NULL + default(8192) 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{s.maxFrameSizeBytes}, 8192), /* keep_alive_enabled NOT NULL + default(true) 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{s.keepAliveEnabled}, true))
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_eqp_socket SET socket_protocol_type = #{s.socketProtocolType}, connection_mode = #{s.connectionMode}, charset = COALESCE(#{s.charset}, charset), heartbeat_enabled = #{s.heartbeatEnabled}, heartbeat_interval = #{s.heartbeatInterval}, read_timeout = #{s.readTimeout}, write_timeout = #{s.writeTimeout}, max_frame_size_bytes = #{s.maxFrameSizeBytes}, keep_alive_enabled = #{s.keepAliveEnabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE eqp_key = #{s.eqpKey}
